Maria (Marketing): Hey team — quick sprint: we need a trimmed battlecard + three one-liners for field + a 10-min webinar hook vs Cloud AI + LLM APIs. Goal: ship initial drafts in 5 days. Who can own the draft?
Samir (Product): I can own the competitive claims. Will post 3 crisp bullets by EOD.
Elaine (Growth): I can sketch the webinar angle — suggest a narrative: cost reduction x predictable latency. Want a concise title too.
Jordan (Sales): Field needs procurement objections (SLA, data residency, migration). Also a short migration cost comparison line.
Lee (Field): I'll run 2 one-liner variants with SDRs. Variant A = econ-first, Variant B = reliability-first.
Nora (DevEx): I'll attach a micro-benchmark snippet we can safe-quote. Need to flag it as synthetic.
Samir (Product): Draft claims (v0.1):
```
- Predictable per-token economics via batching + KV caching — lower tail cost.
- Unified runtime for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — same API, same ops.
- Built-in graceful fallbacks (model variants + region routing) to avoid outages.
```
Samir (Product): Shortenable to 1-line each for the battlecard.
Elaine (Growth): Webinar hook options: 
- "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency"
- "Keep apps online when capacity fails: how graceful fallbacks save deals"
I prefer the first for broad attendance.
Jordan (Sales): Objection handlers (quick):
- Data residency: "Private deployment + KMS/HSM integrations"
- SLA: "Dedicated pools + contractual latency SLOs"
- Migration: "Model pinning + API compatibility layer to reduce rework"
Lee (Field): One-liners for SDR test:
A) "Reduce inference spend by 2x with smart batching and cache-aware serving."
B) "Keep latency predictable at scale — same API across hosted, dedicated, and on-prem."
Nora (DevEx): Micro-benchmark snippet (label: synthetic):
```
p95 latency (short prompt): Redwood-hosted 60ms | Competitor-X 180ms
throughput (gpt-like): Redwood-dedicated 3.2k toks/s | Competitor-X 1.1k toks/s
```
Nora (DevEx): I'll include methodology note in doc.
ops-bot: Document updated: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketing/battlecard-drafts v0.2 :file_folder: :rocket:
Maria (Marketing): Love it. Next steps:
- Samir: finalize 3 one-liners + one-line battlecard copy (due in 24h)
- Elaine: pick webinar title + 1 slide hook (48h)
- Lee: run SDR A/B by Tue morning
- Nora: add benchmark methodology + safe quote line
Jordan: help craft procurement-ready phrasing
Maria (Marketing): Thanks everyone — we'll sync 15m tomorrow to lock. :thumbsup:
